replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.0024132 (0.0033676), N 4862, equals printed Table 6 column (1) 0.002 (0.003), N 4,862, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
outcome_description: transplant-volume-weighted average 3-year post-transplant survival rate at the two airports
notes: Origin-destination airport-pair x year panel 2002-2017, balanced. pair_id = integer code of OrgDestAirport (unit FE and cluster, as vce(cl OrgDestAirport)). gyear = EventYear for treated pairs (treatment_pair==1), NA for never-treated control pairs; D = 1[year >= gyear] equals the authors' TreatmentAfter on every row (checked). Treatment is absorbing (no switch-offs). The 2002 cohort is treated in the first panel year (always-treated): kept in TWFE/BJS samples as in the authors' regression; did::att_gt drops it. Data built in build_and_verify.R from RobustOutcomeAnalysis.dta + CandidateKidneySurvival.dta exactly as do-file lines 346-365 (merge on dest-year and origin-year, keep pairs with all 16 years, volume-weighted survival), then airport_dist >= 800 & year < 2015: 374 pairs x 13 years = 4,862 rows. Cohorts 2015-2017 are untreated in this window and act as never-treated (as in the authors' regression). Authors' line 369: reg survival_3yr_weighted TreatmentAfter TxYear* ODPair* if airport_dist >= 800 & year < 2015, vce(cl OrgDestAirport). fixest: 0.0024132 (0.0033676 Stata dof), N 4,862, adj. R2 0.3747; published 0.002 (0.003), N 4,862, adj. R2 0.376 (adj. R2 differs in the third decimal). The paper text defines a simple average; that version gives 0.0039 (0.0038), adj. R2 0.322, so the code's weighted version is the one in the table. Abstract: 'post-transplant survival rate remains largely unchanged'. Expected run_spec TWFE = 0.0024132 / 0.0311624 = 0.07744.
published_source: Printed Table 6, column (1) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2021.4103.pdf, p. 3675, main text), read Nov 4 2026; table number and values identical to the accepted manuscript in the package; equals the authors' code output to the printed decimals. Earlier: Tr_Tx_final_main_body.pdf (accepted manuscript inside the package); authors' regression re-run in fixest on the shipped analysis .dta (Stata reg with ODPair*/TxYear* dummy sets = fixest pair + year FE with ssc(fixef.K='full'))
